collection.title: Volvo XC70 2000 to 2004 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Volvo XC70 2000 to 2004 model requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 21" blade on the passengers side and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Standard Hook arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm.
